members.name: volume_spike_exhaustion_fade
members.thesis: Exploits 'exhaustion gaps'. A massive volume spike (5x average) on a 1-min bar without a significant price breakout usually indicates a 'climax' where all buyers/sellers are exhausted. This typically leads to a mean reversion as the order book refills. This is a market microstructure phenomenon.
weaknesses: Spikes can be part of a high-frequency wash trade
Requires extremely low slippage to be profitable

members.name: microstructure_volume_reversion_v1
members.thesis: Sudden volume spikes (> 5x 20-bar avg) without proportional price movement (< 0.15% move on the spike bar) indicate institutional accumulation/distribution. The price tends to move in the direction of the volume bar's close relative to its open in the next 10-20 bars. The inefficiency exists because
filters: no trades first 15 min (opening volume is naturally spiky)
weaknesses: 5x volume spike on 1-min can be a single large retail order, not institutional — false positives
Tight target (0.3%) and stop (0.25%) means costs eat a large % of edge — very sensitive to slippage
Low frequency — 5x spikes with small range are rare, may go days without a signal
members.prior_art: Volume spike absorption — institutional microstructure concept; not widely systematized

members.name: inside_bar_breakout_v177
members.thesis: An inside bar represents intraday equilibrium and volatility contraction. A breakout of the inside bar on increased volume indicates a resolution of this equilibrium. Exists because of localized order book vacuums after consolidation.
weaknesses: Extremely susceptible to algorithmic stop hunts (wicks)
Only effective during certain times of the day (e.g., first 2 hours)
Low win rate requires strict discipline on stops

members.name: open_high_low_v1
members.thesis: Exploiting stocks that make open=high or open=low on 1-min as strong directional bias due to institutional conviction at open. Inefficiency from retail chasing momentum without confirmation. Persists because most traders ignore volume filter + index alignment; costs kill discretionary versions.
weaknesses: Regime dependency: worthless in ranging sideways opens
Slippage on fast moves: open=high/low often coincides with news spikes
Crowding: extremely popular on X leading to alpha decay in top names
members.prior_art: Open High Low strategy (classic X thread by @bhaveshp1509)
